# Sketch v3 ready for independent advisor

Turn state: authoring complete; independent fresh signoff pending. No implementation authorization or author approval.

Author: Codex `authority-sketch-v3-author`, native thread `01a11970-6f4f-7c60-8e4f-c910556f0d8a`, Joe-assigned separate revision session, 2026-10-07 America/Phoenix. `AIDA_SESSION_ID` absent; no lease UUID or review grant asserted. Author is not eligible to sign these revisions.

Baseline: main/HEAD `199e591b07aa76a59cd34f0a41946f918501f6ba`; tracked diff against baseline empty before and after authoring. Canonical binary `/home/joe/ai/aida/target/agent/aida` reports 0.15.0, build `199e591b07+dirty`; executable label does not prove byte-for-byte source equivalence.

Read AGENTS.md, two-seat protocol, rework craft/recovery playbooks, aida-orchestrate §3 authoring gate, full canonical owning specs/comments, both v2 sketches and both actual independent signoff reports. Earlier A–E policy answers retained. v1/v2 file bodies verified equal their canonical comments. Prior artifacts preserved byte-for-byte.

Canonical publication/readback

Both full revisions begin `SKETCH (awaiting advisor signoff):` and were posted using the required binary with explicit author `codex/authority-sketch-v3-author`. Each canonical JSON readback contains exactly one byte-equivalent full body (including trailing newline):

- `BUG-1802`: [BUG-1802-sketch-v3.md](BUG-1802-sketch-v3.md); comment `01a1197c-168c-7202-a129-e447a086efd7`; 51042 bytes; SHA256 `165f0ce49e4a80788a9ec4cfa1c1e740c3d06ed694f359a9825e5fe5292d3b1f`.
- `BUG-1808`: [BUG-1808-sketch-v3.md](BUG-1808-sketch-v3.md); comment `01a1197c-257b-72d3-a98b-0509656b8bf7`; 60505 bytes; SHA256 `d9d115040cc34d7dddec7826b1aacc24099c2fcd03f9cc4f010702253fe091de`.

Both statuses remain Approved. Description, status history, queue membership, relationships and every prior comment were verified unchanged. No grant/hold/status/queue changes, production edits, dispatch, approval, commit or merge performed. Requested canonical sketch comments and advisor handoff are the only coordination writes. No tests or live store/user-file/timer/peer experiments ran; every named test is proposed acceptance work.

Concrete revision mechanisms

- BUG-1802: retained PRE-operation source/actor identity, PENDING through callback/crash window, atomic episode completion, source-contributor union, strict unknown-source refusal at both recorder and consumer, START-pinned review head/parent round. Existing manifest/grant/verdict rounds retained; no separate provenance ledger.
- Both: a named parent-owned LaunchPublisher binds actual bootstrap PID/start to manifest/grant/assignment and exact run member/phase/attempt before COMMIT/release. Bootstrap only waits, then execs vendor in place. One direct-vendor phase issuance owner, no recursive delegation. Real TUI PTY entrypoint covered; setup-only activation is separate.
- BUG-1808: HOME coordinator discovered before B locks, durable payload/Git object closure before COMMIT, PREPARED rollback or COMMIT roll-forward, retained receipt before journal cleanup, explicit missing-A refusal and no blind respawn after committed interrupted activation.

Concrete unsupported boundaries for the independent advisor

1. Baseline native `agent new --bg` delegates to Claude's daemon; it exposes no demonstrated pre-exec vendor-PID handshake. v3 explicitly refuses that path before setup. It does not pretend dispatcher PID or parsed session text supplies proof, or silently replace native attach/log semantics. Positive native-background support requires a concrete vendor adapter or separately reviewed AIDA supervisor.
2. Raw standalone Git mutations/opaque imports cannot be classified as ordinary trusted commits from post-hooks. v3 requires the retained parent operation wrapper, otherwise hooks refuse; bypass/missing hooks leave unknown head/gap. Positive standalone raw-Git compatibility needs a concrete pre-operation adapter.
3. Namespace/containment and OS variants without actual host process/peer identity adapter refuse. Missing/moved repository A blocks outstanding home recovery rather than scanning or exposing provisional state.

These are explicit fail-closed design boundaries, not claims of passing positive compatibility tests. The fresh advisor should decide whether those boundaries meet current acceptance or identify the exact required positive adapter as a remaining blocker. No relaxation of acceptance is requested. Final authority-sensitive merge remains Joe's.

Review requested: read the actual INDEPENDENT_SKETCH_V2_SIGNOFF.md and the full v3 bodies. Named witnesses include commit/rewrite new-head barriers through actual review record/pr ship; first-action vendor sentinel before binding/release and parent death; cross-repo queue read/mutation plus authority reads through PREPARED/COMMIT/cleanup/missing A; phase/pane/TUI/resume/nondelegating positives. No witness is claimed as executed or passing.
